name: Virtual Forest
summary: Metsä Group’s Virtual Forest helps forest owner to get familiar with own forest from the comfort of the own sofa. In Virtual Forest you can move around the whole forest property, do the following actions based on your personal forest plan data and see the effects on your forest immediately. You can use Virtual Forest to help and support your decision making. Virtual Forest is available for all Metsä Group’s forest-owner customers when the forest plan data is uploaded to Metsäverkko.
